description.value: BarBurrito is Canada's largest burrito chain, founded in 2005 and now with 385+ locations, serving customizable Mexican-inspired burritos, bowls, tacos, and quesadillas made with fresh in-house ingredients. This Abbotsford location sits in a strip-mall unit on Fraser Highway in the Mt. Lehman area, offering dine-in and takeout as well as delivery via DoorDash and Uber Eats. A solid quick-stop option for touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley looking for a filling, build-your-own meal.
